inputs.text: A hand-drawn 2D comic character in exactly the same illustration style as the input. Fixed full-body shot, the same three-quarter angle facing right. The stocky moustached man lets out a comically annoyed sigh, briefly lowers his free hand from his forehead in a small dismissive gesture, then returns it to his forehead. His other hand keeps the same dirty opaque white ceramic mug steady. Keep the thick irregular black ink outlines, rough watercolor shading, muted colors, facial proportions, clothes, necklace and silhouette consistent throughout. Only the free arm, eyebrows and shoulders move slightly. Static flat gray background, fixed camera, no zoom.
